findings: Missing middleware breaks password reset — Doctor layout reads pathname from headers().get('x-pathname') injected by middleware.ts that doesn't exist. Create middleware.ts at project root with matcher '/doctor/:path*' that adds x-pathname header from request.nextUrl.pathname.

Google OAuth callback route missing — Better Auth config points to /api/auth/callback/google but route doesn't exist. Create callback with manual account linking: verify doctor profile in doctors table before creating session, reject if email not pre-provisioned.

Device tracking headers not sent — trackDevice() requires X-Device-ID header but no client code sends it. Integrate lib/device-id.ts getOrCreateDeviceId() with authenticatedFetch() to inject headers. Mobile needs device_info_plus integration.

Center check-in allows any date — Doctor checkin validates booking.date === today, center checkin doesn't. Add same validation to app/api/center/checkin/route.ts unless backdated corrections are intentional policy.
crypto.randomUUID not imported — Doctor checkout line 131 calls crypto.randomUUID() without import statement. Add 'import crypto from "crypto"' at top.

No rate limiting on password change — /api/auth/change-password-first-login allows unlimited attempts to guess temporary password within 24h window. Add rate limiting (5 attempts per user per hour) or document reliance on expiration as mitigation.

Device OTP email fails silently — sendNewDeviceAlertEmail called without checking return value. If email fails, user never gets OTP and cannot verify device. Check return value and return error to client or create notification.

Better Auth crypto internal API — lib/password.ts imports hashPassword/verifyPassword from 'better-auth/crypto' which may not be stable public API. Verify export stability or use bcrypt directly with same config.
